schema.help: Your own bike or a shared one. Rides just for sport count too.
schema.text: Do you ride a bike or e-bike to get around at least once a week?

ar.#Do you ride a bike or e-bike to get aro: هل تستخدم الدراجة أو الدراجة الكهربائية للتنقل مرة واحدة على الأقل في الأسبوع؟
ar.#Your own bike or a shared one. Rides ju: دراجتك الخاصة أو مشتركة. وتُحسب أيضًا الجولات للرياضة فقط.

de.#Do you ride a bike or e-bike to get aro: Fahren Sie mindestens einmal pro Woche mit dem Fahrrad oder E-Bike, um irgendwohin zu kommen?
de.#Your own bike or a shared one. Rides ju: Ihr eigenes Rad oder ein Leihrad. Fahrten nur zum Sport zählen auch.

en.#Do you ride a bike or e-bike to get aro: Do you ride a bike or e-bike to get around at least once a week?
en.#Your own bike or a shared one. Rides ju: Your own bike or a shared one. Rides just for sport count too.

fa.#Do you ride a bike or e-bike to get aro: آیا حداقل هفته‌ای یک بار برای رفت‌وآمد با دوچرخه یا دوچرخه برقی می‌روید؟
fa.#Your own bike or a shared one. Rides ju: دوچرخه شخصی یا اشتراکی. سواری فقط برای ورزش هم حساب می‌شود.

fr.#Do you ride a bike or e-bike to get aro: Faites-vous du vélo ou du vélo électrique au moins une fois par semaine pour vous déplacer ?
fr.#Your own bike or a shared one. Rides ju: Votre propre vélo ou un vélo en libre-service. Les sorties uniquement sportives comptent aussi.

hu.#Do you ride a bike or e-bike to get aro: Használ kerékpárt vagy e-bike-ot a közlekedéshez legalább hetente egyszer?
hu.#Your own bike or a shared one. Rides ju: Saját vagy megosztott kerékpár. A csak sportolásból tett körök is számítanak.

it.#Do you ride a bike or e-bike to get aro: Vai in bici o in bici elettrica almeno una volta a settimana per spostarti?
it.#Your own bike or a shared one. Rides ju: La tua bici o una in sharing. Contano anche i giri solo per sport.

tr.#Do you ride a bike or e-bike to get aro: Haftada en az bir kez bisikletle veya elektrikli bisikletle yolculuk ediyor musunuz?
tr.#Your own bike or a shared one. Rides ju: Kendi bisikletiniz veya paylaşımlı bir bisiklet. Sadece spor için yapılan sürüşler de sayılır.
